class.name: JRPGSimClock
class.brief_description: Counts the fixed 60 Hz simulation steps of a JRPG.
class.description: Waits, movement and timers count simulation steps instead of seconds, so the game behaves the same at any frame rate and on servers. Each rendered frame, the game passes the frame time to [method advance], runs the steps it returns, and calls [method step] for each of them. At most [constant MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME] steps run per frame: after a long stall the game slows down instead of trying to catch up. Online, each zone server owns the clock of the maps it simulates.

method.name: advance
method.description: Adds [param delta] seconds of frame time and returns how many steps are due now, from 0 to [constant MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME]. It does not change the step count. Zero, negative and NaN frame times add nothing.

method.name: get_steps
method.description: Returns how many steps have run.

method.name: reset_pending_time
method.description: Drops frame time that has not become a step yet, for example after loading or a pause.

method.name: set_steps
method.description: Sets the step count (when loading). Negative values are refused.

method.name: step
method.description: Counts one step and returns the new total.

constants.constant: Most steps [method advance] returns for one frame.
